name: subagent-labels
description: Show human-readable subagent identities and task summaries at startup.

interface.shortDescription: Replace bare UUID-only subagent startup activity
interface.longDescription: Packages the transcript-aware labeler used by the project SubagentStart hook. The hook reads the child transcript, resolves its generated nickname and role, and emits a concise human-readable task label.
defaultPrompt: Show a human-readable label when each subagent starts.
